Finished floor Z32.000 → sole underside Z32.250 =0.250 gap.
NOMINAL FOOT STACK · SAME DATUM FOR ALL FOUR FEET
Steel rail top / cap underside: Z31.003937
Cap top: Z31.628937
Spacer length = 15.775 mm
Sole bottom / top: Z32.250 / 32.750
Leg centreline over foot centre. Front1.5 sq / rear 2 sq.
4 × Ø0.5625 holes at local X±0.875;Y±2.000.
LOAD PATH AND ACCESS
Leg → upper ribs / sole → spacer annuli / bolts.
Cap → lower ribs / cheeks → retained seat rail.
Cap-to-sole gap is open except four spacer annuli.
Plate outer edges are not supported by the floor.
Nominal rib-to-Ø1.250 socket radial clearance0.0625.
This excludes weld fillets, coating and actual tools.
Rear V limits long axial socket approach from above.
Use short-socket side access proposal; validate tools.
No positive locking method or torque is yet released.
64 hardpoints / regular coach. Per foot: cap1,sole1,cheeks2,spacers4,lower ribs2,upper ribs2,bolts4,washers8,nuts4.
True cut is through foot centre. Bolts behind the section plane project into view; thread and washer representations are nominal envelopes.
Nominal floor gap stays0.250in. Actual fit, distortion, spacer tolerance, floor-edge closeout and minimum loaded clearance need verification.
Short socket / side-access geometry and weld-adjacent clearance require inspection with chosen commercial tools before release.
